title: 問路
description: 詢問與指引方向的表達

sentences.en: Excuse me, I am looking for the national museum, which I believe is somewhere in this neighborhood, but I seem to have gotten completely turned around.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我在找國立博物館，我相信它就在這附近，但我似乎完全迷路了。

sentences.en: If you walk straight along this road for about three blocks and then turn right at the intersection with the traffic light, you will see the entrance on your left.
sentences.zh: 如果你沿著這條路直走大約三個街區，然後在有紅綠燈的路口右轉，你會看到入口在你左手邊。

sentences.en: Could you point me in the direction of the nearest pharmacy, which I urgently need to find because I have run out of my prescription medication?
sentences.zh: 你能指引我最近的藥局在哪個方向嗎？我急需找到，因為我的處方藥用完了。

sentences.en: The landmark you should look for is a tall clock tower made of red bricks, which stands directly opposite the building you are trying to find.
sentences.zh: 你應該找的地標是一座紅磚砌成的高鐘塔，它就在你要找的建築物正對面。

sentences.en: I would not recommend taking that shortcut through the alley because it is poorly lit at night and can be quite confusing for someone unfamiliar with the area.
sentences.zh: 我不建議走那條巷子的捷徑，因為晚上照明很差，對不熟悉這一帶的人來說可能很容易搞混。

sentences.en: Once you reach the roundabout where five roads converge, take the second exit on the right, which leads directly to the shopping district near the waterfront.
sentences.zh: 到達五條路交匯的圓環後，走右邊第二個出口，它直通濱水區附近的購物區。

sentences.en: The post office you are looking for was relocated last month to a new building situated behind the supermarket on the corner of Oak Street and Maple Avenue.
sentences.zh: 你在找的郵局上個月搬遷到了位於橡樹街和楓葉大道轉角超市後面的新大樓。

sentences.en: Although the map on my phone suggests turning left here, I have a feeling that going straight and then turning at the next block would be a shorter route.
sentences.zh: 雖然我手機上的地圖建議在這裡左轉，但我覺得直走然後在下一個街區轉彎會是更短的路線。

sentences.en: You cannot miss it because there is a large fountain in the plaza directly in front of the building, which is usually surrounded by street performers in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 你不會錯過的，因為建築物正前方的廣場有一座大噴泉，下午通常有街頭藝人圍繞著。

sentences.en: The fastest way to get to the train station from here, especially if you are in a hurry, is to cut through the park and exit through the north gate.
sentences.zh: 從這裡到火車站最快的方式——特別是如果你趕時間的話——是穿過公園從北門出去。

sentences.en: I am afraid you have been walking in the wrong direction because the harbor district is actually to the south, which is completely opposite to where you are heading.
sentences.zh: 恐怕你一直走錯方向了，因為港區其實在南邊，跟你正在走的方向完全相反。

sentences.en: After crossing the pedestrian bridge that goes over the highway, you will find yourself on a tree-lined boulevard where the embassy buildings are all located.
sentences.zh: 過了跨越高速公路的人行天橋後，你會來到一條兩旁種滿樹的大道，大使館建築都在那裡。

sentences.en: The street you are looking for runs parallel to the river and is easily identifiable because all the buildings along it have distinctive blue awnings.
sentences.zh: 你在找的那條街與河流平行，很容易辨認，因為沿街所有建築物都有醒目的藍色遮陽篷。

sentences.en: Would you happen to know if there is a pedestrian crossing nearby that would allow me to get to the other side of this busy six-lane road safely?
sentences.zh: 你是否知道附近有沒有行人穿越道，可以讓我安全地到達這條繁忙六線道馬路的對面？

sentences.en: The building is set back from the main road and somewhat hidden behind a row of tall trees, which is why most visitors have difficulty finding it on their first attempt.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築離主幹道有一段距離，隱藏在一排高大的樹木後面，這就是為什麼大多數遊客第一次都很難找到。

sentences.en: If you follow the signs pointing toward the city center, which are posted at every major intersection, you should arrive at the square within fifteen minutes on foot.
sentences.zh: 如果你跟著指向市中心的標誌走——每個主要路口都有標示——步行十五分鐘內應該就能到達廣場。

sentences.en: I suggest taking the underground passage rather than crossing at street level because the traffic here is extremely heavy and the nearest crosswalk is two blocks away.
sentences.zh: 我建議走地下通道而不是在地面穿越，因為這裡交通非常繁忙，最近的行人穿越道在兩個街區外。

sentences.en: The hotel where you have your reservation is located on a one-way street, so you will need to approach it from the eastern end if you are coming by car.
sentences.zh: 你訂的飯店在一條單行道上，所以如果開車來的話，需要從東邊進入。

sentences.en: Judging by the direction you described, I believe you may have confused the north exit with the south exit, which are on completely opposite sides of the station.
sentences.zh: 根據你描述的方向，我認為你可能把北出口和南出口搞混了，它們在車站完全相反的兩側。

sentences.en: There used to be a direct path connecting these two streets, but it was closed for construction last year, so now you have to go around the entire block.
sentences.zh: 以前有一條直接連接這兩條街的路，但去年因施工而封閉了，所以現在你必須繞整個街區。

sentences.en: The GPS keeps trying to route me through a road that appears to be permanently closed, so I would really appreciate any local knowledge you could share about alternative ways.
sentences.zh: GPS一直試圖把我導到一條似乎已永久封閉的路，所以如果你能分享替代路線的在地知識，我會非常感激。

sentences.en: You will know you are getting close when you start to see the cathedral spire rising above the rooftops, as it is the tallest structure in the entire old town area.
sentences.zh: 當你開始看到教堂尖塔高出屋頂時，就知道快到了，因為它是整個舊城區最高的建築。

sentences.en: Rather than walking all the way around the lake, which takes about forty minutes, you could take the ferry that crosses it in just five minutes.
sentences.zh: 與其繞湖走一圈——大約要四十分鐘——你可以搭只需五分鐘就能橫越湖面的渡輪。

sentences.en: The alley that leads to the hidden garden is easy to miss because its entrance is tucked between a bookstore and a small café with no visible signage.
sentences.zh: 通往隱密花園的小巷很容易錯過，因為它的入口夾在一間書店和一間沒有明顯招牌的小咖啡館之間。

sentences.en: If you happen to pass by a large mural depicting ocean waves on the side of a building, that means you have gone about two blocks too far north.
sentences.zh: 如果你經過一面建築物側面畫有海浪的大型壁畫，那表示你已經往北多走了大約兩個街區。

sentences.en: The pedestrian zone, which extends from the main square all the way to the riverbank, is clearly marked with special paving stones that are different from the regular sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 行人徒步區從主廣場一直延伸到河岸，以與普通人行道不同的特殊鋪路石清楚標示。

sentences.en: I would recommend downloading an offline map of this district before you explore further, since the mobile signal tends to be quite weak in the narrow streets of the old quarter.
sentences.zh: 我建議你在進一步探索前下載這個區域的離線地圖，因為舊城區狹窄街道的手機訊號通常很弱。

sentences.en: The intersection ahead can be confusing because three streets merge into one, but if you stay to the right and follow the tram tracks, you will end up at the market.
sentences.zh: 前面的路口可能會令人困惑因為三條街合而為一，但如果你靠右走沿著電車軌道，就會到達市場。

sentences.en: Provided that the construction on Bridge Street has been completed, the most direct path to the concert hall would be straight down that road for approximately ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 假如橋街的施工已經完成，去音樂廳最直接的路就是沿那條路直走大約十分鐘。

sentences.en: Be careful not to confuse the two parks in this area, because the one you want, which has the famous rose garden, is actually behind the courthouse and not next to the school.
sentences.zh: 小心不要搞混這一帶的兩個公園，因為你要去的那個有著名玫瑰園的公園其實在法院後面，不是在學校旁邊。
